ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.4:1 ratio of high-intensity (light grey/white) pixels to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-frequency mottling pattern consisting of small, stochastic high-intensity focal spots and irregular geometric clusters distributed over a low-intensity base. Clusters show higher density along the trailing margins and at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 35 degrees relative to the longitudinal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge. The amplitude of these variations increases significantly at the distal tips, creating a ragged, irregular boundary profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex sweep along the trailing edge of both the left and right lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle attachment scars) distributed across the central and distal regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant raggedness and apparent tissue loss/irregularity at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting heavy wear or past colonization by epibionts.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke exhibits a dense 'pointillist' pigmentation pattern across the entirety of the visible ventral surface, lacking large solid regions of either high or low intensity.
